gui.guildmark.tale.lute.title: The Silent Lute
gui.guildmark.tale.lute.step.0: A bard has lost her songs
gui.guildmark.tale.lute.step.2: The lute must be paid for
fortune.guildmark.reason.tale.lute.redee: %1$s's lute was redeemed, and the square rang again.
fortune.guildmark.reason.tale.lute.parts: %1$s's lute was redeemed in two parts.
fortune.guildmark.reason.tale.lute.lent: %1$s played one night on a borrowed lute.
fortune.guildmark.reason.tale.lute.silen: %1$s's lute was sold, and the square stayed quiet.
fortune.guildmark.reason.tale.why.lute.l: The times were lean, and the bard pawned her lute.
fortune.guildmark.reason.tale.why.lute.f: Ribbonwake was near, and the bard wanted her lute for it.
Sunhearth was near, and the bard wanted her lute for it.
Sheafmoot was near, and the bard wanted her lute for it.
Lanternrise was near, and the bard wanted her lute for it.
fortune.guildmark.reason.tale.why.lute.u: Nobody had taken it up, so the keeper's price stood for any who came.
fortune.guildmark.reason.tale.why.lute.r: %s chose to redeem the lute at once.
fortune.guildmark.reason.tale.why.lute.p: %s chose to redeem the lute in two parts.
fortune.guildmark.reason.tale.why.lute.v: %s gave their word, and the keeper lent the lute for a night.
fortune.guildmark.reason.tale.why.lute.h: %1$s paid the first %2$s Marks, and the bard had her lute in her hands again; the rest was due in %3$s days.
fortune.guildmark.reason.tale.why.lute.p: %s paid what was owed, and the lute was redeemed.
fortune.guildmark.reason.tale.why.lute.r: %s paid the rest, and the lute was redeemed.
fortune.guildmark.reason.tale.why.lute.p: The bard played in the square at dusk.
fortune.guildmark.reason.tale.why.lute.u: No one came to the keeper in time.
fortune.guildmark.reason.tale.why.lute.s: No Marks came, and the keeper sold the lute to a passing trader.
The rest was not paid in time: what was paid was given back, and the keeper sold the lute to a passing trader.
fortune.guildmark.reason.tale.why.lute.k: No one was left to hold the lute.
